findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` turns off `local_options` itself instead of enabling it. The `nomatch` change (and any option nvm set earlier in the function) is therefore not restored when `nvm_list_aliases` returns. In zsh, after running `nvm ls` or `nvm alias`, the user's interactive shell keeps `nomatch` off, so an unmatched glob such as `ls *.nomatch` is passed through literally instead of raising 'no matches found'. The intended form is `setopt local_options nonomatch`.
